notes: Complete name and objective lists exist only for Hirschfelden and Layton Lake District. Cuatro Colinas, Emerald Coast Australia, Askiy Ridge and Intisuyu have full name lists rebuilt from TacMaps URL slugs, without objectives. For the other reserves, the file gives mission givers and arcs (from achievements), official mission counts and the few mission names that could be confirmed. Mission rewards (XP and cash) are not listed in any source that could be reached. The fandom wiki, which has full lists, is blocked here.

Medved-Taiga.about: Official count: 32 missions and 50 side missions (Steam store). Story: you are contracted to assist climatologist Alena Khasavovna's expedition. Mission arcs, from achievements: Dr. Alena Khasavovna ('The Apex Hunter'), Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev, Dr. Columbus Neidell, Dimitri "Dimi" Pushkin, Georgy Grankin, Katerina Khasavovna and Dr. Svetlana Isakova. 'Medved-Taiga National Park Arc' requires all missions, side missions included.

Vurhonga Savanna.about: Official count: 16 narrative missions, 32 side missions and 14 warden missions (Steam store). Your grandfather, Senior Warden Njabulo Tshabangu, asks for your help. Arcs, from achievements: Warden Missions, Maria Mboweni, Flip Ospreay, Dana Maritz and Brother. 'Vurhonga Savanna Arc' requires all arcs.

Parque Fernando.about: Official count: 16 narrative missions and 39 side missions (Steam store). The owner is Carolina Vargas. Arcs, from achievements: Carolina Vargas ('The Truth is in the Milanesa'), Vicente Vargas, Beatriz 'Chinita' Cabrera, Matias 'Matmat' Mateo, Dr. Mariana Luna and Juliana Ferrari. Also has a 'Trophy Collection' (one diamond of each species for the lodge; achievement 'A Sample of Parque Fernando's Finest') and 15 Challenge Targets (see collectibles.json).

Yukon Valley.about: Official count: 10 narrative missions and 42 side missions (Steam store). A player count on Steam found 10 main missions from warden Jim Murray, plus side missions from Kayla Johnson (8), Bev Parker (6), Sandy Murray (7), Hank Pepper (6) and Oscar Freeman (8), 35 in total. Achievement 'A Step Closer to Sourdough': complete the main arc. 'Yukon Valley Arc': complete all arcs.

Cuatro Colinas.about: Official count: 14 narrative missions and 55 side missions (Steam store); 67 mission pages are listed below. Warden: Doña Alejandra del Bosque Garcia. Achievements: 'Justice is served' (main arc), 'Cuatro Colinas Arc' (all arcs), 'A Reddish Carpet' (complete 'Red Carpet'). Character arcs, from achievements: Faith (Padre Abbas), Hubris (Gerhardt Baden), Tradition (Antonia Acosta Gonzalez), Commitment (Sole Santiago Serrano), Rebirth (Don Del Bosque), Opportunism (Jose Ruiz Hernández).
